decisions.reason: Using the customer-design font sizes does not change the separate dynamic bullet-count, overflow-shrinking, or unresolved slides 7 and 19 behavior.
This Requirement governs graphic bullets in Microsoft Word templates, while the source decision applies to the new PowerPoint template.
The PowerPoint font-size decision does not change the Word template's Tab-driven list hierarchy.
The source concerns typography in a customer-designed PowerPoint template and does not alter the required Word style catalog.
The PowerPoint font-size specification has no necessary effect on legacy-content pasting behavior in the Word templates.
The source decision does not change Word table or column containment after pasted content.
The PowerPoint design's font sizes are unrelated to manual line-break behavior after pasting into Word templates.
The source decision does not alter the Word style prefix, application condition, or naming language.
The source specifies PowerPoint design typography and does not change the supported Word environment or its reliability constraints.
The caption typography applies specifically to image and table labels in Word; the customer-design PowerPoint font sizes do not replace it.
The existing 40pt Word title rule remains valid and is not superseded by font sizes from the separate PowerPoint customer design.
The source decision does not modify the Word Heading 3 size or bold-weight requirement.
